newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips further on tech weakness.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips further on tech weakness.

text.p: Nasdaq shares slipped further Tuesday, despite a late rally, as gloom lingered over technology stocks, traders said.
The Nasdaq Composite Index lost four points, or 0.30 percent, to close unofficially at 1331. The Dow industrials gained 52 points, or 0.76 percent, to close unofficially at 6858.
"It was a busy day, but things felt soft to us overall. Everything tech-related felt like death," one trader said.
Monday's broad sell-off in technology stocks infected most of Tuesday's session.
Late buying, which pushed the Nasdaq index up about 11 points in the last 20 minutes of trading, left some technology companies modestly higher for the day.
"There was a late burst, but that doesn't make up for Monday's bloodbath," another trader said.

Intel gained 1/8 to 151-3/4 and Microsoft rose 3/4 to 98-1/2. Networking stocks faced more rating cuts, pushing Ascend Communications down 2-1/4 to 59-1/2 and U.S. Robotics off 2-3/8 to 59-1/2. 3Com showed a slight gain after Monday's drop, up 1/4 to 37-1/2. Losses beat gains 2447 to 1919 on 663 million shares.
